steps.text: If the player has completed Imp Catcher:

steps.npc: So you think finding those beads makes you clever, do you?
Well you'd better just watch your back, because when you least expect it I'll be there. You shouldn't go sticking your nose into other people's affairs, meddler.

steps.text: If the player has started Imp Catcher:

steps.npc: You're a fool, [player name]. Do you really think you'll find four imps out of thousands? Good luck. Ha!

steps.text: If the player has not started Imp Catcher:

steps.npc: Not now, I'm trying to concentrate on a very difficult spell!

steps.text: If the player has started or completed the 20th Anniversary event:

steps.player: You were nicer to me when you had that little gnome wandering around here before.

steps.npc: Well he's not bothering me anymore, is he? And you don't need to bother me either!

steps.text: If the player has completed the 25th Anniversary event:

steps.player: You seemed like a completely different person when you were complimenting Gary on his ritual that opened the Realm of Memories.

steps.npc: My son's a smart kid who's becoming a great wizard, while you're a do-gooder who fetches & carries stuff for smarter people. I know which of you two earned my respect.
